subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, quadras, quadrinhas, parlendas, trava-línguas, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto e relacionando sua forma de organização à sua finalidade.

components.description_pt: Ler quadras, parlendas e trava-línguas com apoio de colegas e professor
components.description_en: Read quadras, parlendas, and tongue twisters with peer and teacher support
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level poetry with prompting and support, demonstrating basic comprehension

components.description_pt: Identificar situação comunicativa e tema de gêneros textuais do cotidiano
components.description_en: Identify the communicative situation and topic of everyday-life text genres
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main topic of an informational text with prompting and support

components.description_pt: Explicar como forma organizacional de texto conecta-se ao seu propósito comunicativo
components.description_en: Explain how the organizational form of a text connects to its communicative purpose
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

components.description_pt: Compreender significado de textos de gêneros do cotidiano com apoio contextual
components.description_en: Comprehend the meaning of short everyday-life genre texts with contextual support
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-appropriate informational texts with prompting and support

cc_matches.description: With prompting and support, read prose and poetry of appropriate complexity for grade 1.
With prompting and support, identify the main topic and retell key details of a text.
With prompting and support, read informational texts appropriately complex for grade 1.
Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
